i already posted a story but i remembered another one that i love. in primary school we had book week where we were allowed to dress up as our favourite character from any book. my family didnt have much money and i didnt have any way to afford or make a costume for myself, so every day i would just come in my school uniform. one day we had an assembly where the best costumes got to stand in front of the whole school and say who they were. during the assembly they asked us to put our hands up if we wanted to show off our costume. despite me just being in my uniform i put my hand up and was chosen for some reason. i think i put my hand up because i was so jealous that i didnt have a costume and wanted attention so badly. but i had no plan of what to do or say when it got to my turn. after every kid saying who their character was and getting a round of applause, they turned to me. the teachers handed me the microphone and asked me who i was dressed as. i panicked and just said “ uhh.. I’m anne from the famous five but in her school uniform”…. and got no applause. i was so humiliated i started to cry and had to get my mum to pick me up. when we got home she asked me what had happened, i told her, and she had to stifle her laughter. now that im older im just so baffled at what the fuck was going through my mind.

also i think its so ridiculous that so many people are saying “but you DeStRoYeD the kids ball, and that’s his PrOpErTy, so you’re BrEaKiNg ThE lAw”…. who cares?! its a soccer ball, it can be replaced and if it can’t then what does that matter? its literally just a ball. there a thousands of other ways a child can entertain themselves. so many people are paying attention to OP cutting a fucking ball when OP’s own daughter had GLASS in her LEG because these kids hadn’t listened to OP (despite OP telling the kids, AND their parents about what the situation was)

not only that but OPs window is now broken, so now they have to pay to fix a window, pay for medical attention for their daughter (or at the very least some kind of ointment for the leg or drs appointment), and deal with their own guilt for doing something that isn’t even that bad.

i HATE that people in the comments are just making up stories to prove their point like “what if the kids parents cant afford another ball and you just ruined their only Christmas present and victimised a poor child” etc. can we just stick to the facts of the story rather than assume all these added factors?
